engineering_gate: Existing independently checked gate; contributes no points. Failure makes the preliminary score zero.
unit_scale: Existing published integer 0..4 C/S/F anchors. This pass codes existing Qwen descriptions; it is not a new listening review or expert adjudication.
unit_quality: q=min(C,S,F)/4 for O/P; each group unit-weighted equally.
aggregation: Compute the formula separately for each clip; average A/B/C equally. Original frozen scorer/plan/status remain unchanged.
unknown_policy: Misread P pauses and absent B-N descriptions remain unknown, not measured failures. Report bounds 0..4; use 2 only as an explicitly unvalidated midpoint imputation for a preliminary point estimate.
C_O07_policy: Existing low-confidence evidence reports no usable target. Point C=F=0; sensitivity upper C=F=2. Not independently confirmed deletion.
metric_use: eSTOI/SI-SDRi are cross-check evidence for relative enhancement only; neither is multiplied by 100 or equated to C/S/F. No empirically uncalibrated metric thresholds added.
timing: Same sample counts, unchanged video and source audit support the timeline; no independently certified lip-sync grade is claimed.
qualitative_B: A=1 for frequent warbling/noise; B=4 from existing positive continuity report; C=1 for persistent artifacts and reported tail loss. B is a particularly uncertain positive estimate.
sensitivity: Bounds vary missing ratings and C-O07 only. They are not statistical confidence intervals and exclude possible systematic Qwen errors.
